Project 1 Milestone#2

This milestone creates the relations from the ER from Phase B to complete Phase C and then creates the following tables from the relations for Phase D.

	- There are no specific "commands with relevant command-line arguments, parameters that depend on the mysql server and database that need to changed, etc." You can just run the files   



Files:
The files included:
1. createAll.sql - This creates the database as well as the tables, so the other files won't be able to run the others without this first.
2. loadAll.sql - loads the data into the tables. 
3. dropAll.sql - drops all tables
